name: INDEPENDENCE
description:
## Description

"A preamplifier with a simple configuration that thoroughly pursues transmission characteristics.The internal structure consists of only an equalizer amplifier and a buffer amplifier.The equalizer stage consists of eight low-noise tubes and consists of a two unit amplifier, a direct-coupled differential type. The RIAA equalizer is a CR type, sandwiched between the stages of the unit amplifier to ensure accurate gain distribution and eliminate coloring."

name: BATTLER
description:
## Description

"Monaural power amplifier designed to demonstrate the ability of the EL 156vacuum tube.EL 156made by Telefunken is used for the vacuum tube.The vacuum tube circuit as a preconceived concept was completely scrapped, and the transistor circuit technique was incorporated into the design.In addition, we use carefully selected parts including wiring materials.The circuit configuration is a direct-coupled DC type drive stage with two differential stages and a parallel push-pull type with four EL 156terminals for the final stage.Equipped with an NF control switch that can control the amount of NFB, 0dB/6dB/12dB can be selected."

name: HL-22
description:
## Description

"This head amplifier is designed to avoid degradation of sound quality caused by complicated wiring such as switching circuits, and to obtain sufficient performance for music reproduction at low cost.High-quality parts such as ultra-low noise FET are used inside.The chassis structure is completely enclosed in a thick steel box with a double-shield gain stage and a triple-shield power supply.All accessory circuitry has been eliminated for simplicity, with only power switches, pin jacks and direct output cords providing a simple appearance."
